compression_rule: This capability SHALL remain independently meaningful and SHALL NOT be reduced to a generic Observer label.
distinctive_invariant: Category insufficiency does not authorize invention of a different underlying object.
evidence_rule: Observer output SHALL remain evidence-bounded and SHALL NOT silently strengthen uncertainty, visibility, or claim status.
provenance_rule: Every material result SHALL remain attributable to Observer identity, operation identity, bound Room/revision/view, evidence references, applicable ceiling, and disposition.
purpose: Observe hybrid conditions, category violations, incompatible-property pressure, and evidence that does not reconcile cleanly with its apparent classification.
questions: Does the object exhibit supported properties that cross expected categories?
Does the apparent classification fail to contain the observed evidence?
Are incompatible properties simultaneously present without justification for inventing a new object?
